review_scope: Selected eclipse interpretation in hash-verified cached QLP SAP, with bounded follow-up where decisive.
evidence: The S5 1444.76 and S98 4012.56 selected depressions sit within broad, evolving undulations lasting roughly days; S5 has several similarly smooth troughs and S98 has changing wave shape and data gaps. Neither selected window is a discrete repeating eclipse with measured same-kind timing.
interpretation: The observed morphology supports variable continuum rather than the selected eclipse claim. The underlying variability may be astrophysical.
limitations: No secure eclipse period, depth or source-specific geometry is measured; a different binary signal is not excluded.
catalogue_status: UNKNOWN; VSX, ASAS-SN, Kostov table 3/4 unavailable
